$comment: Which crypto providers advertise which algorithms, and from which version.
Referenced by EXEC-DET-005, which deliberately does NOT hardcode a version
comparison in the rule. 'bcprov < 1.78 lacks ML-KEM' is training knowledge, not
a corpus fact, and it goes stale. Keeping it here makes it data someone owns and
can correct, and an entry that is absent produces a finding that says so rather
Definitive confirmation comes at build time from EXEC-VER-007, which observes
what the resolved provider actually advertises.

ML-KEM.note: ML-KEM (FIPS 203) exposed through the BC provider.

providers.note: JOSE/JWT signing. Not a key-establishment provider; no ML-KEM path.
